diagnosis: With 1250ms remaining, onTick takes 300ms; the displayed 2 seconds are now stale. Recomputing ceil from the later clock schedules 950ms until zero instead of a zero-delay correction to 1 second. Schedule against the boundary of the value actually emitted, clamped to 0..1000ms.
